title: Oracle: archive logs removed; the update reports COMPLETED while flows fail

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3, gateway runtime 18.3

symptom: ORACLE_ARCHIVE_LOG_FILES_UNAVAILABLE on the gateway's flows: "... Please perform full refresh on all destination tables mapped to catalog <catalog> ...". The ingestion update reported COMPLETED.
cause: The archive logs the CDC needed were removed.
effect: Rows are missing while the update status says COMPLETED.
fix: Full refresh the destination tables; read the gateway's flow events, not the update status.
notes: LogMiner's text in another case: No complete archived dictionary found before SCN. The removal is container-wide: a second gateway on the same container, whose CDC had finished, went to INGESTION_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ERROR ("cannot recover") (tested 2026-10-26).
